This route allows you to fetch one or more self-service actions and/or automations in your Port account.

The call will perform a logical `AND` between all query parameters below, and return all actions and automations that match the criteria.

To learn more about actions and automations, check out the [documentation](https://docs.port.io/actions-and-automations/).

:::info Version parameter
Set the `version` parameter to `v2` for the latest version of the API.:::

query.description: The identifier/s of the action/s and/or automation/s you want to fetch.
The identifier/s of the action/s and/or automation/s you want to fetch.
The identifier/s of the blueprint/s whose actions/automations you wish to fetch.
The identifier/s of the blueprint/s whose actions/automations you wish to fetch.
The [operation type/s](https://docs.port.io/create-self-service-experiences/setup-ui-for-action/#basic-details) of the action/s you want to fetch. Relevant only for self-service actions.
The [operation type/s](https://docs.port.io/create-self-service-experiences/setup-ui-for-action/#basic-details) of the action/s you want to fetch. Relevant only for self-service actions.
Only relevant for **automations**. If `true`, only published automations will be fetched.
The event/s that triggered the automation/s you want to fetch. Relevant only for automations.
The event/s that triggered the automation/s you want to fetch. Relevant only for automations.
Specifies the API version to use. Please use `v2` for the latest version of the API.
